description: Header file defining structures, types, and function prototypes for managing TrueType font objects within the FreeType project, including driver, glyph slot, graphics state, code ranges, transformations, size metrics, and driver functions.

classes.name: TT_GraphicsState
classes.description: Structure representing the TrueType graphics state used during bytecode interpretation.

classes.name: TT_SizeRec_
classes.description: Structure representing size metrics and related data for TrueType fonts.

classes.name: TT_DriverRec_
classes.description: Structure representing the TrueType driver class with associated functions and zone.

methods.name: tt_face_init
methods.description: Initializes a TrueType face object from a stream.

methods.name: tt_face_done
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up a TrueType face object.

methods.name: tt_size_run_fpgm
methods.description: Runs the font program bytecode for a size object.

methods.name: tt_size_run_prep
methods.description: Runs the prep bytecode for a size object.

methods.name: tt_size_ready_bytecode
methods.description: Prepares bytecode for a size object.
